mapper.sql: i.inbound_seq, i.inbound_no, i.inbound_type, i.order_seq, i.plant_seq, i.warehouse_seq, i.supplier_seq, i.planned_date, i.inbound_status, i.arrived_at, i.arrived_by, i.vehicle_no, i.driver_name, i.arrive_remark, i.canceled_by, i.canceled_at, i.cancel_reason, i.remark, i.created_by, i.created_at, i.updated_by, i.updated_at, o.order_no AS order_no, pl.plant_id AS plant_id, pl.plant_name AS plant_name, pl.org_seq AS org_seq, w.warehouse_id AS warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name AS warehouse_name, s.supplier_id AS supplier_id, s.supplier_name AS supplier_name, au.user_name AS arrived_by_name

FROM tb_inbound i JOIN tb_plant pl ON pl.plant_seq = i.plant_seq JOIN tb_warehouse w ON w.warehouse_seq = i.warehouse_seq LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_order o ON o.order_seq = i.order_seq LEFT JOIN tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_seq = i.supplier_seq LEFT JOIN tb_user au ON au.user_id = i.arrived_by

, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tb_inbound_line l WHERE l.inbound_seq = i.inbound_seq) AS line_count , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.planned_qty), 0) FROM tb_inbound_line l WHERE l.inbound_seq = i.inbound_seq) AS total_planned_qty , (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(l.arrived_qty), 0) FROM tb_inbound_line l WHERE l.inbound_seq = i.inbound_seq) AS total_arrived_qty

where.if: AND (i.inbound_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR i.remark ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR o.order_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR s.supplier_name ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_inbound_line l JOIN tb_sku sk ON sk.sku_seq = l.sku_seq WHERE l.inbound_seq = i.inbound_seq AND sk.sku_id = #{skuId})

mapper.select: SELECT l.line_seq, l.inbound_seq, l.line_no, l.sku_seq, l.order_line_seq, l.planned_qty, l.arrived_qty, l.remark, sk.sku_id AS sku_id, sk.color_code AS color_code, sk.size_code AS size_code, p.product_id AS product_id, p.product_name AS product_name, b.brand_name AS brand_name, ol.order_qty AS order_qty, ol.remain_qty AS order_remain_qty FROM tb_inbound_line l JOIN tb_sku sk ON sk.sku_seq = l.sku_seq JOIN tb_product p ON p.product_seq = sk.product_seq JOIN tb_brand b ON b.brand_seq = p.brand_seq LEFT JOIN tb_purchase_order_line ol ON ol.line_seq = l.order_line_seq WHERE l.inbound_seq = #{inboundSeq} ORDER BY l.line_no

SELECT l.line_seq, l.inbound_seq, l.line_no, l.sku_seq, l.order_line_seq, l.planned_qty, l.arrived_qty, l.remark, sk.sku_id AS sku_id FROM tb_inbound_line l JOIN tb_sku sk ON sk.sku_seq = l.sku_seq WHERE l.line_seq = #{lineSeq}
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_inbound SET inbound_type = #{inboundType}, order_seq = #{orderSeq}, plant_seq = #{plantSeq}, warehouse_seq = #{warehouseSeq}, supplier_seq = #{supplierSeq}, planned_date = #{plannedDate}, remark = #{remark}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE inbound_seq = #{inboundSeq}

UPDATE tb_inbound SET inbound_status = #{toStatus},
arrived_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, arrived_by = #{actor}, vehicle_no = #{vehicleNo}, driver_name = #{driverName}, arrive_remark = #{arriveRemark},
canceled_by = #{actor}, canceled_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason},
updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE inbound_seq = #{inboundSeq} AND inbound_status = #{fromStatus}
UPDATE tb_inbound_line SET arrived_qty = #{arrivedQty}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE line_seq = #{lineSeq}
mapper.select: SELECT remain_qty FROM tb_purchase_order_line WHERE line_seq = #{orderLineSeq}

SELECT ol.line_seq AS order_line_seq, ol.line_no AS line_no, ol.sku_seq AS sku_seq, ol.remain_qty AS planned_qty, ol.order_qty AS order_qty, ol.remain_qty AS order_remain_qty, sk.sku_id AS sku_id, sk.color_code AS color_code, sk.size_code AS size_code, p.product_id AS product_id, p.product_name AS product_name, b.brand_name AS brand_name FROM tb_purchase_order_line ol JOIN tb_sku sk ON sk.sku_seq = ol.sku_seq JOIN tb_product p ON p.product_seq = sk.product_seq JOIN tb_brand b ON b.brand_seq = p.brand_seq WHERE ol.order_seq = #{orderSeq} AND ol.remain_qty > 0 ORDER BY ol.line_no
